author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: camera body with a viewfinder hump and a round lens under it, carried by a strap arching from the body's top corners. A reference-faithful candidate (straight triangular strap, no hump; saved in the run history of this module) passed validation but was nearly identical to the rejected drawing and read as a hanging picture frame; the hump cannot fit under straight strap runs (7 units), so the strap became an arch that clears it.
omissions: The strap is an arch rather than the reference's straight triangle, so the viewfinder hump can stay; the small flash circle is dropped (it cannot sit 8 from both the lens and the body edges); the lens is one ring instead of two concentric rings.
drawing_plan: Mirrored about x=24: body r3 rect x 6..42, y 18..42 with hump (19,18)-(21,15)-(27,15)-(29,18); lens r4 at (24,29); strap cubic arch (9,18)-(24,6)-(39,18).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'camera' (rounded body, raised top, circular lens); strap arch as in 'handbag'/'briefcase' handles.
